datasets.title: Eurostat: value added, hours worked, final energy, time use, consumption and prices for EU services, 1995-2025
datasets.description: Seven Eurostat API responses, kept byte for byte, that together measure the inputs of the service sector in the EU and its member states: real and nominal value added and hours worked by NACE A*10 industry, final energy consumption by sector, HETUS time use (2000 and 2010 waves), per-capita consumption, population and HICP services prices. Snapshotted because Eurostat's API serves only the current vintage of each dataset.
datasets.snapshot: Eurostat dissemination API, JSON-stat 2.0, seven queries retrieved 2026-11-22T20:10:07Z; each file records its upstream update timestamp

datasets.title: INE Portugal: median new-lease rents, 2025
datasets.description: Official indicator 0014698: median monthly rent per square metre of gross private area for new family-dwelling leases in 2025, methodology 2026 and NUTS 2024 geography.
